scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The counterexample and kernel-perturbation proof are exact symbolic arguments. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: The exact if-and-only-if uniqueness criterion is asserted only for finite-dimensional K-frames admitting a strict scaling. The general outer-product criterion is prior ordinary-frame theory and is not claimed as new.

title: Pairwise-distinct norms do not force unique \(K\)-frame scalings
